name: Astor Enerji
verdict: A BIST-listed Turkish transformer maker controlled by the Gecgel family.
note: Rating note: Astor Enerji is the EuroLeague/Turkey Ligi forma onu (front) sponsor of Fenerbahce Tarfin from September 2026. BIST-listed (ticker ASTOR) with about 42.75% free float; Feridun Gecgel holds 37.25% of capital (62.68% of voting rights) and his brother Enver Gecgel about 20%. On 2026-09-27 the CMB (SPK) placed precautionary measures on the Gecgel family's assets and companies in a fund investigation, and lifted them the same weekend after a re-evaluation (KAP notice 1668403) - no finding against the company is recorded. ON HOLD: a proposed 'none' rating waits on the ownership claim's second independent source; the precautionary-measure episode is news reporting, not a court or regulator finding, so it is not recorded as a record claim.
